newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ciampi sees Italy joining EMU on time.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi sees Italy joining EMU on time.

text.p: Italy will be among the countries which qualify for European currency union in 1999, Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Saturday in an interview with the German newspaper Welt am Sonntag.

According to an advance summary of an article to appear in the newspaper on Sunday, Ciampi said: "We will present ourselves in the kind of condition which will ensure a positive decision," when the decision is made in March/April 1998 as to who will qualify for monetary union.
Ciampi said Italy would not use a possible loosening of fiscal requirements to meet the tough financial criteria established in the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to join EMU in 1999.
"It is in Europe's best interests to have a strong Euro. We couldn't allow the strong deutschemark to be replaced by a weak Euro," said Ciampi.
